items.title: Review: In Maine, a new approach to practicing medicine in the sky
items.summary: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

items.title: Review: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades
items.summary: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.

items.title: Review: For Trump and America, a Clear Election Verdict but a Murky Future
